nodes.label: Prompt Caching (MiniMax)
nodes.rationale: Automatic passive caching reduces latency and cost for repeated system prompts, tool lists, and multi-turn history.

nodes.label: Tool Use & Interleaved Thinking (M3)
nodes.rationale: M3 reasons between each tool round; the full assistant response incl. thinking blocks must be appended to history to keep the reasoning chain continuous.

nodes.label: npm run lint silent no-op (client)
nodes.rationale: client/biome.json root:false resolves to repo biome.json which excludes client via !client, so lint never scans the client tree.

nodes.label: Dead imports in Overview.tsx
nodes.rationale: noUnusedLocals is off so tsc misses Stat/StatSkeleton unused imports; Biome would catch them once lint actually runs.

nodes.label: Kiro CLI Reverse-Engineering Notes
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for the cli persona wire format; accuracy is the entire value because looking byte-identical to kiro-cli reduces ban risk.

nodes.label: Notion Desktop Capture Notes v2
nodes.rationale: Notion AI chat is a CRDT sync protocol with NDJSON patch diffs, not a chat-completion API; fidelity of fingerprinting determines whether Notion flags the account.

nodes.label: Pioneer Authentication (X-API-Key)
nodes.rationale: Single long-lived X-API-Key header, no OAuth refresh, no anthropic-version — simplest auth model among the providers.

nodes.label: Pioneer pioneer/ namespacing for global uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Pioneer ids clash with Kiro/CodeBuddy ids but models.name and upstream_model are globally unique, so rows are namespaced under pioneer/ in both columns and stripped on egress.
nodes.norm_label: pioneer pioneer/ namespacing for global uniqueness

nodes.label: 001-initial consolidated migration
nodes.rationale: Folding 002-010 into a single fresh-deploy schema means existing DBs keep working (runner skips) while fresh installs reach the final schema in one step.

nodes.label: errorRules.ts decision flow
nodes.rationale: Two-layer decision (base_resp.status_code then HTTP/text matching) lets MiniMax semantic codes override generic HTTP handling.

nodes.label: getSetting returns null not undefined
nodes.rationale: Repos coerce ?? null to satisfy T|null signatures and tests rely on null vs undefined distinction.

nodes.label: CodeBuddy OpenAI Bridge Plan
nodes.rationale: CodeBuddy upstream is OpenAI stream-only and requires a system message; Anthropic passthrough returned 11101, so convert Anthropic->OpenAI on ingress and OpenAI SSE->Anthropic SSE on egress.

nodes.label: Provider Prefix Routing Plan
nodes.rationale: Explicit mm/kr/cb/pio/nt prefix makes the provider assertable from the model string and lets bare names resolve only through aliases/combos.

nodes.label: Console Flow Consistency Plan
nodes.rationale: Five proxy handlers emitted inconsistent console events; Notion was silent and combo legs lost the parent reqId, so unify via parentReqId param + buildStart-before-account-select.

nodes.label: Models page prefix display/delete Plan
nodes.rationale: Pioneer seeds leaked 139 rows with anthropic/pioneer/ duplicates against globally-unique name+upstream_model, so dedup via migration 009 and surface client call string pio/... in the dashboard.

nodes.label: Notion Provider Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Mirror kiro.ts+codebuddy.ts 1:1 but replace static refresh token with 3-step OTP login and add conversation_routing table for chat continuity across requests.

nodes.label: 2026-06-19 Audit Fixes Plan
nodes.rationale: Six remaining audit findings (A4 family persist, A5 quota parallel, A6 admin cache TTL, A7 settings null, B1 combo/alias symmetry, B2 alias source update) fixed as targeted TDD patches.
